source: UNIBEN B.Eng Petroleum Engineering course structure (eng.uniben.edu), petroleum and thermo-fluid courses only; the engineering core (GET) is added from the CCMAS handbooks. UNIBEN's list is not CCMAS-coded and has no 100 level. Drilling Technology appears twice as "I" at 200 and 300 level; the 300-level one is read as II.

courses.name: General Chemistry I
courses.general_name: Atomic Structure, Bonding and Physical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Atomic structure, periodic table, bonding, stoichiometry, states of matter, gas laws, thermochemistry and chemical equilibrium.

courses.name: General Chemistry II
courses.summary: Kinetics, electrochemistry, acids and bases, periodic trends, main-group chemistry, and introduction to organic compounds and reactions.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry I
courses.summary: Safe lab practice, volumetric analysis, titrations, qualitative tests and simple physical-chemistry experiments.

courses.name: General Practical Chemistry II
courses.summary: Qualitative inorganic analysis, organic functional-group tests, kinetics and electrochemistry experiments.

courses.name: Engineer in Society
courses.general_name: Introduction to the Engineering Profession and Society
courses.summary: Engineering disciplines, history, ethics, COREN and professional bodies, safety, sustainability and the engineer's duty to society.

courses.name: Engineering Graphics and Solid Modelling I
courses.general_name: Engineering Drawing and Computer-Aided Design I
courses.summary: Drawing instruments, lettering, orthographic projection, sectioning, dimensioning and an introduction to 2D CAD.

courses.name: Communication in English
courses.general_name: Academic English: Communication Skills and Writing
courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture
courses.general_name: Nigerian Peoples, Cultures and Heritage (African Studies)
courses.summary: Survey of Nigeria's major ethnic groups, pre-colonial states, colonial rule, religion, family, arts and the cultural values behind national identity and unity.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics I
courses.general_name: Pre-calculus: Algebra, Trigonometry and Coordinate Geometry
courses.summary: Sets, number systems, polynomials, inequalities, functions, logarithms, trigonometry, complex numbers and sequences.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics II
courses.summary: Limits, continuity, differentiation, applications of derivatives, integration, areas and volumes, and basic differential equations.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics III
courses.general_name: Vectors, Analytic Geometry and Introductory Mechanics
courses.summary: Vector algebra, lines and planes in space, conic sections, kinematics, statics and particle dynamics.

courses.name: General Physics I
courses.general_name: Introductory Mechanics and Properties of Matter
courses.summary: Units and dimensions, vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, work, energy, momentum, rotational motion, gravitation, elasticity and fluids.

courses.name: General Physics II
courses.summary: Electric fields, potential, capacitance, DC circuits, magnetism, induction, AC basics, then waves and optics.

courses.name: General Physics III
courses.general_name: Introductory Heat, Thermodynamics, Waves and Optics
courses.summary: Temperature, heat transfer, gas laws, laws of thermodynamics, oscillations, wave motion, sound, light and optical instruments.

courses.name: General Physics IV
courses.summary: Atomic structure, quantum ideas, radioactivity, nuclear physics, relativity basics and introductory semiconductor electronics.

courses.name: General Practical Physics I
courses.summary: Measurement, error analysis and experiments in mechanics, heat and properties of matter, with report writing.

courses.name: General Practical Physics II
courses.summary: Experiments in electricity, magnetism, optics and waves, with graph work and error analysis.

courses.name: Probability I
courses.summary: Sample spaces, counting, conditional probability, Bayes' rule, random variables, expectation and common distributions.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
courses.summary: Types of enterprise, opportunity spotting, business ideas, innovation, simple business plans, startup financing and the Nigerian small-business environment.

courses.name: Applied Electricity I
courses.general_name: Basic Electrical Circuits and Machines for Engineers
courses.summary: DC and AC circuit laws, network theorems, magnetism, transformers and introduction to electrical machines and measurements.

courses.name: Engineering Materials
courses.summary: Atomic structure, crystal structures, mechanical properties, metals, polymers, ceramics, composites, corrosion and material selection.

courses.name: Engineering Graphics and Solid Modelling II
courses.general_name: Engineering Drawing and Computer-Aided Design II
courses.summary: Isometric and auxiliary views, assembly drawings, 3D solid modelling and CAD practice.

courses.name: Students Workshop Practice
courses.summary: Hands-on use of hand tools and machines: fitting, welding, machining, carpentry and sheet metal, with workshop safety.

courses.name: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics
courses.summary: Fluid properties, hydrostatics, continuity, Bernoulli's equation, momentum, pipe flow and dimensional analysis.

courses.name: Fundamentals of Thermodynamics
courses.summary: Energy, first and second laws, properties of pure substances, ideal gases, entropy and basic power and refrigeration cycles.

courses.name: Applied Mechanics
courses.summary: Force systems, equilibrium, friction, centroids, moments of inertia, kinematics and kinetics of particles and rigid bodies.

courses.name: Strength of Materials
courses.summary: Stress and strain, axial, torsion and bending loads, shear and moment diagrams, deflection, buckling and combined stresses.

courses.name: Engineering Mathematics I
courses.general_name: Advanced Calculus and Linear Algebra for Engineers
courses.summary: Multivariable calculus, series, matrices, determinants, eigenvalues and ordinary differential equations.

courses.name: Engineering Mathematics II
courses.general_name: Differential Equations and Transforms for Engineers
courses.summary: Higher-order differential equations, Laplace transforms, Fourier series, vector calculus and complex variables.

courses.name: Computing and Software Engineering
courses.general_name: Programming and Software Engineering for Engineers
courses.summary: Algorithms, programming in a high-level language, problem solving with code, basic software life cycle and tools.

courses.name: SIWES I (Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme)
courses.summary: Supervised short industrial placement (about 9 weeks) after second year: workplace observation, logbook and a placement report.

courses.name: Philosophy, Logic and Human Existence
courses.general_name: Introduction to Philosophy, Formal Logic and Ethics
courses.summary: Branches of philosophy, the nature of knowledge and existence, deductive and inductive reasoning, fallacies and argument analysis, and basic moral theory.

courses.name: Basic Petroleum Engineering
courses.summary: Oil and gas origin, exploration, drilling, production and surface facilities.

courses.name: Drilling Technology I
courses.summary: Rig components, drilling methods and wellbore basics.

courses.name: Engineering Computer Programming
courses.summary: Programming for engineering calculations.

courses.name: Venture Creation
courses.summary: Turning an idea into a registered business: market research, business model, financing, legal registration, marketing and a start-up plan.

courses.name: Engineering Mathematics III
courses.summary: Partial differential equations, vector analysis, complex analysis and numerical methods used in engineering analysis.

courses.name: Engineering Mathematics IV
courses.summary: Numerical analysis, optimisation, statistics and transform methods applied to engineering problems.

courses.name: Technical Writing and Communication
courses.summary: Technical reports, proposals, documentation, presentations, correspondence and referencing.

courses.name: Engineering Statistics and Data Analytics
courses.general_name: Statistics and Data Analytics for Engineers
courses.summary: Descriptive statistics, probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis tests, regression, quality control and data-analysis tools.

courses.name: Renewable Energy Systems and Technology
courses.summary: Solar, wind, hydro, biomass and geothermal resources, conversion technologies, storage, grid integration and energy policy.

courses.name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Convergent Technologies
courses.general_name: Introduction to AI, Machine Learning and Emerging Technologies
courses.summary: Concepts of AI and machine learning, data, simple models, ethics, and convergent technologies such as IoT, robotics and blockchain.

courses.name: Engineering Economics
courses.summary: Time value of money, cash-flow analysis, project appraisal, depreciation, cost-benefit analysis and replacement decisions.

courses.name: SIWES II (Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme)
courses.summary: Supervised 12-week placement after third year with deeper hands-on work in a firm, a logbook and an assessed report.

courses.name: Peace and Conflict Resolution
courses.summary: Causes and types of conflict, Nigerian conflict case studies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and peace-building institutions.

courses.name: Thermodynamics I
courses.summary: Laws of thermodynamics and properties of substances.

courses.name: Thermodynamics II
courses.summary: Cycles, mixtures, combustion and refrigeration.

courses.name: Fluid Mechanics
courses.summary: Fluid statics, flow, pipe systems and machinery.

courses.name: Petroleum Geology
courses.summary: Origin, migration and trapping of hydrocarbons.

courses.name: Well Testing and Analysis
courses.summary: Pressure transient tests and reservoir parameters.

courses.name: Computer Applications in Petroleum Engineering
courses.summary: Software for reservoir, drilling and production analysis.

courses.name: Drilling Technology II
courses.summary: Directional drilling, casing and cementing.

courses.name: Engineering Geology
courses.summary: Rocks, minerals, geological structures, groundwater, site investigation and geohazards for engineering works.

courses.name: Reservoir Geomechanics
courses.summary: Rock stress, deformation and wellbore stability.

courses.name: Drilling Fluid Systems and Engineering
courses.summary: Mud properties, hydraulics and solids control.

courses.name: Formation Evaluation
courses.summary: Log and core analysis to determine reservoir properties.

courses.name: Engineering Project I
courses.summary: Student chooses a supervised problem, reviews literature, sets objectives and methods, and presents a proposal.

courses.name: Engineering Valuation and Costing
courses.summary: Cost estimation, bills of quantities, tendering, asset valuation and depreciation for engineering works.

courses.name: SIWES III (Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme)
courses.summary: Final 12-week placement after fourth year with project-level duties, supervisor assessment and a report.

courses.name: Petroleum Engineering Laboratory
courses.summary: Lab tests on rocks, fluids and drilling muds.

courses.name: Quality, Health, Safety and Environment Studies
courses.general_name: Quality, Health, Safety and Environment Studies
courses.summary: QHSE standards, risk and environmental compliance.

courses.name: Well Test Analysis
courses.summary: Advanced pressure-test interpretation.

courses.name: Offshore Technology
courses.summary: Platforms, subsea systems and marine operations.

courses.name: Well Logging
courses.summary: Logging tools and log interpretation.

courses.name: Reservoir Engineering I
courses.summary: Fluid properties, reservoir drive and material balance.

courses.name: Oil and Gas Production Technology I
courses.general_name: Oil and Gas Production Technology I
courses.summary: Well completion, artificial lift and flow performance.

courses.name: Engineering Project Management
courses.summary: Project life cycle, scheduling (CPM/PERT), resource planning, risk, quality, procurement and project control.

courses.name: Engineering Law
courses.summary: Law of contract, tort and negligence, professional liability, intellectual property, labour and engineering regulations in Nigeria.

courses.name: Project
courses.summary: Supervised independent project: problem definition, literature review, method, results, dissertation and oral defence.

courses.name: Oil Field Development I
courses.summary: Field appraisal, development planning and economics.

courses.name: Oil Field Development II
courses.summary: Facilities design, recovery plans and decision analysis.

courses.name: Reservoir Engineering II
courses.summary: Water influx, decline analysis and recovery.

courses.name: Reservoir Engineering III
courses.summary: Enhanced recovery and reserve estimation.

courses.name: Oil and Gas Production Technology II
courses.general_name: Oil and Gas Production Technology II
courses.summary: Surface facilities and separation.

courses.name: Oil and Gas Production Technology III
courses.general_name: Oil and Gas Production Technology III
courses.summary: Production optimisation and well stimulation.

courses.name: Natural Gas Engineering
courses.summary: Gas properties, flow, measurement and transport.

courses.name: Natural Gas Processing
courses.summary: Dehydration, sweetening, NGL recovery and LNG.

courses.name: Numerical Methods
courses.summary: Numerical methods for engineering and reservoir problems.

courses.name: Elements of Reservoir Simulation
courses.summary: Reservoir models and simulators.

courses.name: Oil Recovery Processes
courses.summary: Primary, secondary and enhanced oil recovery methods.
